for the project.

PMBOK Guide 7th edition . Page 64

q.en: You have just assigned as project manager for a large manufacturing project. You want to understand the process for preparing a project scope statement and how formal acceptance of the completed project deliverables will be obtained. Which of the following will you have to reference?

en: The stakeholder management plan
The requirements management plan
The quality management plan
The scope management plan

x.en:
SCOPE MANAGEMENT PLAN
The scope management plan is a component of the project management plan that describes how the scope will be
defined, developed, monitored, controlled, and validated. The components of a scope management plan include:
uu Process for preparing a project scope statement;
uu Process that enables the creation of the WBS from the detailed project scope statement;
uu Process that establishes how the scope baseline will be approved and maintained; and
uu Process that specifies how formal acceptance of the completed project deliverables will be obtained.
The scope management plan can be formal or informal, broadly framed or highly detailed, based on the needs
of the project.

PMBOK Guide 6th edition , Page 137

 

 Scope management plan. This plan is a component of the project or program management plan that describes how the scope will be defined, developed, monitored, controlled, and validated.

PMBOK Guide 7th edition , Page 187

q.en: During the development of the scope management plan , a stakeholder requests the addition of pilot technology into the project scope to assist with product marketing . What should the project manager do?

en: Use the project reserve for the pilot technology
Increase the project budget with the cost of the pilot technology
Review the scope baseline with the stakeholder
Include the stakeholder in the scope planning meetings

x.en: During the development of the scope management plan , a stakeholder requests the addition of pilot technology into the project scope to assist with product marketing so the project manager should Include the stakeholder in the scope planning meetings .

q.en: You are running one week behnid on a project due to delivery by a vendor.You are forced to compress your project schedule due to a government - mandated end date that constrains your project. After meeting with your team , you found a method to compress the project without adding more resources or increase the project cost . This is an example of which of the following?

en: Crashing
Fast tracking
Risk mitigation
Resource leveling

x.en:
Fast Tracking. A schedule compression method in which activities or phases normally done in sequence are performed in parallel for at least a portion of their duration.
PMBOK Guide 7th edition , Page 52

q.en: You are the project manager of the GHY software project for your company. You've recently completed the project and need to distribute the project closure report. Who should get a copy of the project closure report?

en: Project sponsor
Follow the guidelines established in the project's communications management plan
No one . It is created for future historical information
All stakeholders

q.en: An organization has historically executed most projects using a predictive approach. The organization now wants to change over to an agile approach . Due to this change , the project manager is worried about the scope definition process for upcoming projects. What should the project manager do to ensure the scope is completely defined?

en: Meet with the general manager and convince them to return to use the predictive approach to avoid any risk.
Ask the sponsor to increase a budget to check if every business needs are included in the requirements.
Help sponsors and stakeholders craft the product vision and bring the team and product owner together to clarify the expectations.
Ask the general manager to review every requirement to ensure that all projects will deliver the required products .

x.en: The project manager should help sponsors and stakeholders craft the product vision and bring the team and product owner together to clarify the expectations to ensure the scope is completely defined in agile approach.

q.en:
You are a project manager working on a critical project. Some stakeholders have complaints about some of the team member's performance . You want to understand the situation and provide feedback to the team as soon as possible. 

What three actions should you take to address this situation? Choose three

en: Perform a daily team meeting
Request a manager performance review
Perform a retrospective session
Conduct an annual review
Define team ground rules

x.en: Some stakeholders have complaints about some of the team member's performance , so the project manager should (1-Define team ground rules , 2-Perform a retrospective session , 3-Perform a daily team meeting) to understand the situation and provide feedback to the team as soon as possible.

q.en:
A project development team is located in different areas around the world. Last week , avery important release was delayed because one of the developers did not respond on time to an email that was sent to everyone. The developer seems to have missed reading the email.

What should the project manager do to avoid these situations?

en: Review the stakeholder engagement plan
Review the communications management plan
Review the risk management plan
Review the resource management plan

x.en:
Keyword (The developer seems to have missed reading the email. )
The project manager should Review the communications management plan to ensure the agreed-upon methods and types of communication. Because it is clear in the scenario that the email was not agreed upon as a way of communication with the developer. Therefore , the communication management plan must be reviewed and updated if necessary to include all communication needs of all stakeholders in the project.

q.en: An agile project's sponsor has indicated that a particular stakeholder group has not been engaged in the project. What should the project manager do?

en: Call a meeting with the project team to determine why the stakeholder has not been engaged and who is accountable.
Meet with the stakeholder group to capture their interests and project requirements , and add these to the product backlog.
Engage the product owner, indicating the sponsor's concerns, and request the appropriate next steps.
Review the communications management plan to determine how the stakeholders on the project were planning to be involved

x.en:
Keyword ( Agile )
An agile approach is concerned with the continuous involvement of stakeholders, so the project manager should Meet with the stakeholder group to capture their interests and project requirements , and add these to the product backlog.

q.en: A customer is concerned about the time required to complete a project and is asking the project team to reduce the number of iterations required to complete the product. Which approach should the project manager take?

en: Prioritize deliverables based on business value and define frequent releases.
Ask the team to raise blockers or impediments in daily meetings.
Ask the team to challenge the project estimations for faster delivery.
Prioritize the tasks with high risks to reduce the number of iterations required.

x.en: The project team want to reduce the number of iterations required to complete the product so the project manager should Prioritize deliverables based on business value and define frequent releases

q.en: A project manager is working on a project to build a manufacturing complex. The project will run in three different phases: engineering, procurement, and construction. The procurement phase is in the initiation stage. The project sponsor wants to pursue the project phases as they have been planned, but also wants to accommodate and adjust to new data, input from the customer, and changes during the various phases as the project progresses. How should the project manager approach this project?

en: Evaluate and decide on a phased project management approach
Use a hybrid model to combine predictive and adaptive lifecycles.
Apply a predictive project management approach
Implement an adaptive project management approach

x.en: Since The Project sponsor wants to accommodate and adjust to new data, input from the customer, and changes during the various phases as the project progresses. So the project manager should Use a hybrid model to combine predictive and adaptive lifecycles.

q.en: An organization is transitioning to an agile approach. At the projects first, sprint review, the product owner did not accept the result of the sprint and has some concerns. What should the project manager do?

en: Ask the product owner to accept the outcome since the team delivered what was agreed in the sprint planning
Create a record in the issue register and escalate the issue to the project steering committee
Ask the project team to address the product owner's issues since the product owner is responsible for the scope in agile
Organize a sprint retrospective and discuss the issues and how they can be avoided in the next sprint

x.en: During the Sprint Retrospective, the team discusses: What went well in the Sprint. What could be improved? What will we commit to improve in the next Sprint so the best option " Organize a sprint retrospective and discuss the issues and how they can be avoided in the next sprint".

q.en: A junior project manager was recently hired to lead a complex project scheduled to kick off in 2 weeks. The junior project manager was introduced to another project manager for mentoring .Which two benefits will the junior project manager realize by being assigned to a mentor? (Choose two).

en: The mentor can provide past project documentation with early warning indicators that potential problems could occur
The mentor will be immediately available to takeover the project if there are problems or project delays
The mentor will be involved in the decision-making processes implemented by the junior project manager
The junior project manager reports administratively to their mentor so that human resource(HR) questions can be answered quickly.
The mentor will be immediately available to takeover the project if there are problems or project delays

x.en:
The two benefits will the junior project manager realize by being assigned to a mentor

1- The junior project manager can discuss certain problems with their mentor without fear of retribution

2- The mentor can provide past project documentation with early warning indicators that potential problems could occur

q.en: After a project status meeting, the project manager realizes that the project is under budget, quality checks are positive, and the schedule variance is negative. How should the project manager qualify the project status?

en: Ahead of schedule
Behind schedule
On schedule
Stopped

x.en: The schedule variance is negative, so the project is Behind schedule

q.en: An agile team is facing a challenge with the quality of its deliverables. Every time a feature is promoted to production, many defects arise, preventing the customers from properly using the solution. What should the project manager do to avoid this situation in the future?

en: Reduce the release cycle and invest more time on the current features instead of releasing new ones
Create a team incentive program with prizes, allowing the team members to work overtime to find defects
Hire a quality assurance specialist and integrate a second phase of testing into the current project life cycle
Use the next retrospective to understand the root cause of the quality issues and have the team come up with an action plan.

x.en: Many defects arise, preventing the customers from properly using the solution so the project manager should Use the next retrospective to understand the root cause of the quality issues and have the team come up with an action plan and to avoid this situation in the future.

q.en: A project manager has just taken over a project that is in the requirements gathering phase. A stakeholder indicates that they have not received any progress updates even though reports have been sent on a weekly basis. What should the project manager do to ensure all stakeholders are receiving proper information about the project?

en: Create daily progress reports and send them to all stakeholders
Include stakeholders in the weekly status meetings with the team
Hold a steering committee meet ng with all stakeholders to provide a comprehensive update on the project progress
Assess all of the project stakeholders and document their preferred communication method and frequency.

x.en: The project manager to ensure all stakeholders are receiving proper information about the project, he should Assess all of the project stakeholders and document their preferred communication method and frequency.

q.en: A project team began working on a complex project that involves new technology as a product. The team is new to the technology and the proposed approach. Additionally, the customer is apprehensive about how the product will be received in the market. What should the project manager do to help the team and the customer?

en: Manage the risks associated with the proposed approach.
Assist the team with identifying the minimum viable product(MVP) to validate assumptions.
Coordinate with the business unit to get detailed requirements.
Work closely with the marketing team on market research and product segments.

x.en: The team is new to the technology and the proposed approach in additional to the customer is apprehensive about how the product will be received , so the project manager should Assist the team with identifying the minimum viable product(MVP) to validate assumptions.

q.en: A project manager is leading a project that will be delivered using a Scrum framework. The organization has an innovative project management office (PMO) that fully supports agile and also has a very friendly procurement team. A new vendor needs to be engaged to provide more developers for a new reporting platform. What should the project manager do?

en: Consult the development team and engage a vendor that is recommended by them
Use an agile approach and engage a vendor that delivered well in a previous organization
Use a formal approach using procurement policies, procedures, forms, and work instructions
Consult the product owner and engage a vendor that is recommended by them.

x.en: A new vendor should be engaged as per a formal approach using procurement policies, procedures, forms, and work instructions.

q.en: A project manager is implementing an enterprise-wide software project. The project has a great business impact and is fully supported by senior management. However, the project manager is facing difficulties getting the support of several key departments. What should the project manager do?

en: Convince senior management to introduce rewards to resisting departments
Understand the user concerns and revisit the stakeholder engagement plan
Ask senior management to communicate with these departments
Hire a project management consultant to help resolve the issue

x.en: The Project manager should Understand the user concerns and revisit the stakeholder engagement plan to get the support of several key departments.

q.en: In an organization with a good work-life balance, one team was continuously overloaded, thereby delivering the product late with poor quality. What should the project manager do?

en: Request the replacement of certain team members
Request management for a high-performing team
Request the team to work more for on-time delivery
Request the team to focus on doing better planning

x.en: Because there isnot good planning ,one team was continuously overloaded, thereby delivering the product late with poor quality so the project manager should request the team to focus on doing better planning.

q.en:
A project manager brings in a new team member from an agile environment to work in a predictive environment. The project manager expects to leverage the new team member's agile experience with the existing team members.
What should the project manager do to integrate the new team member effectively?

en: Set expectations with the new team member and explain what is needed
Acknowledge that hiring this new employee is a risk to the existing team
Meet with all team members and explain the new employee's position.
Train the new team member in the predictive project management approach.

x.en: A new team member worked in agile environment and he will transfer to work in predictive environment so the project manager should set expectations with the new team member and explain what is needed to integrate the new team member effectively

q.en: In a project using a hybrid approach, the performance of the team was consistently excellent during the predictive stages. When the iterations began, however, the team members started to show signs of low commitment, conflicts, and confusion, resulting in low morale. What should the project manager do to handle this situation?

en: Identify the team members who are impacting low morale.
Perform team-building activities and enhance collaboration
Give team members more authority to make decisions.
Coach the team members on agile processes and knowledge

x.en:
Keyword (When the iterations began, the team members started to show signs of low commitment)
SO the project manager should Coach the team members on agile processes and knowledge to fill this gap.

q.en: A product owner presented the backlog to the team, and the team raised concerns over implementing some of the features due to various impediments. What should the project manager suggest that the product owner do next?

en: Estimate the financial impact of the impediments and request additional funding
Begin to remove the impediments, starting with the easiest ones first, to foster team accomplishment
Capture the impediments and inform management that their assistance is needed in resolving the impediments
Ensure that the impediments are captured and prioritized based upon the highest valued features

x.en: The project manager should suggest that the product ownerEnsure that the impediments are captured and prioritized based upon the highest valued features to reduce team concerns over implementing some of the features due to various impediments.

q.en: A certain stakeholder keeps asking for changes to the project scope that are not consistent with the original project requirements. One of the changes was requested one month before the project launch date. This change is projected to cause significant project delays. What should the project manager do?

en: Continue with the launch date as per the approved project management plan.
Inform the project steering committee about the project delay risk.
Update the change management document.
Submit a change request to the change control board (CCB).

x.en: Keyword (changes to the project scope - cause significant project delays ) .. The project manager should Submit a change request to the change control board (CCB) for reviewing and approval.

q.en: You are a project manager in a construction project. The project is ahead of schedule and under budget. A key stakeholder then suggests a change to include a value-added feature that wouldn't impact project schedule and cost. What should you do next?

en: Advise the stakeholder that changes shouldn't be implemented when a project is behind schedule.
Evaluate the change's impact with the team.
Update the project management plan to include the new feature.
Advise the stakeholder that, since the project is under budget, the feature will be added

x.en: The change does not impact the schedule and cost but the project manager should Evaluate the change's impact with the team on other project constraints.

q.en: A project manager wants to measure velocity as the indicator of the agile team's progress. Which of the following metrics is best for the project manager to use for this purpose?

en: The number of iterations completed by the team per release
The number of user story points completed by the team per iteration
The number of story points planned to be completed in the next iteration
The number of user story points completed by the team per day

x.en: Velocity is typically calculated as the sum of story points sizes for the features actually completed during an iteration. Agile Practice Guide -PMI, Page(s) 61, 64

q.en: ------------------- can be defined as a technique to operate Scrum at scale for multiple teams working on the same product, coordinating discussions of progress on their inter-dependencies, and focusing on how to integrate the delivery of software, especially in areas of overlap.

en: Scrum
Large Scale Scrum (LeSS)
Unified scrum
Scrum of scrums

x.en: Scrum of Scrums: A technique to operate Scrum at scale for multiple teams working on the same product, coordinating discussions of progress on their interdependencies, and focusing on how to integrate the delivery of software, especially in areas of overlap. [Agile Practice Guide, 1st edition, page 154].

q.en: You are managing a large construction project. Your project team works in two different buildings across the city. You want to communicate the vision and inspire the project team to achieve high performance. Which of the following skills help the project manager?

en: Feedback
Emotional intelligence
Political awareness
Leadership

x.en: Successful projects require leaders with strong leadership skills. Leadership is the ability to lead a team and inspire them to do their jobs well. It encompasses a wide range of skills, abilities, and actions. Leadership is important through all phases of the project life cycle. There are multiple leadership theories defining leadership styles that should be used as needed for each situation or team. It is especially important to communicate the vision and inspire the project team to achieve high performance.

q.en: During a team meeting, your team members don't remain on topic and often interrupt each other. This causes the meeting to take longer than planned. As a project manager, what should you do?

en: Conduct the ground rules.
Co-locate the team members in a place which is suitable to team
Direct the meetings.
Better manage the communication channels

x.en: Ground rules, defined in the team charter are established to set clear expectations regarding acceptable behavior by the project team members. So the project manager should Escalate ground rule to comply bt team members and remain on topic and do not interrupt each other.

q.en: Mark is managing an airport construction project. He is currently assessing stakeholder aspects like their interests, rights, ownership, knowledge, and contributions. What will be your preference of technique to work this out?

en: Root cause analysis
Stakeholder mapping using salience model
Stakeholder analysis
Stakeholder engagement plan

x.en: Stakeholder analysis results in a list of stakeholders and relevant information such as their positions in the organization, roles on the project, "stakes," expectations, attitudes (their levels of support for the project), and their interest in information about the project. Stakeholders' stakes can include but are not limited to a combination of interest, Rights, contribution and ownership.

q.en: During the initiation phase, the project manager classifying a list of project stakeholders and discovers an interested stakeholder with little authority. How should manage this stakeholder?

en: Keep informed
Monitor
Manage Closely

x.en:
Very Important question in Real Exam

The stakeholder is interested in the project with little authority so you will keep him informed.

Sakeholder analysis, stakeholders are assessed based on two primary dimensions:

 
 Power (influence/authority)
 
 
 Interest (level of involvement or concern)
 

If a stakeholder has high interest but low power, the correct engagement strategy is to:

👉 Keep Informed

 
 Ensure they are regularly updated with relevant information.
 
 
 Engage them as needed to maintain their support and interest.
 
 
 They may influence others or become more powerful in the future.
 

 📚 Reference:
 
 
 PMBOK® Guide – 6th Edition, Chapter 13: Project Stakeholder Management
 
 
 Stakeholder Engagement Assessment Matrix (Power/Interest Grid)

q.en: You are a Project Manager for an infrastructure development project. An unidentified stakeholder is not happy with your project performance. He has asked for some updates to perform on the project. As a project manager, what should you do next?

en: Implement the change
Issue a change request to change control board (CCB)
Update stakeholder register
Analyze the impact of the request on the project

x.en: Keyword (Unidentified stakeholder) you should first update the stakeholder register.

q.en: When a new influential stakeholder joins the organization and will be responsible for a few aspects of the project. What should the project manager do first to engage this stakeholder effectively?

en: Update the RACI chart with the responsibilities of the new stakeholder
Revise the stakeholder engagement assessment matrix
Submit a change request to update the stakeholder engagement plan
Schedule a meeting with the new project stakeholder

x.en: The Manage Stakeholder Engagement process is the process of communicating and working with stakeholders to meet their needs and expectations, address issues, and foster the appropriate stakeholder involvement. In order to effectively manage the new stakeholder's level of engagement, the project manager must understand, among other things, the stakeholder's requirements and expectations. Meeting with the stakeholder provides an opportunity for the project manager to establish a relationship and gather the necessary information from the stakeholder to engage him effectively. Therefore, of the available options, the first thing for the project manager to do is meet with the stakeholder to learn the stakeholder's requirements and expectations for the project. The incorrect answer choices represent actions that may not be necessary, or the project manager does not have enough information to perform at this point.

q.en: Project team members are developing a document that describes values that are important to the team's success such as sharing best practices, listening to each other with an open mind, and communicating respectfully during meetings. Which of the following describes this document?

en: Resource management plan
Team charter
Resource calendars
Communication management plan

x.en: The team charter is a document that records the team values, agreements, and operating guidelines, as well as establishing clear expectations regarding acceptable behavior by project team members.

q.en: After a high-level management meeting, the manager chairing the meeting asks the Project Manager to document and communicate the action items to all the stakeholders. The Project Manager is part of a________________ organization.

en: Balanced Matrix
Strong Matrix
Tight Matrix
Weak Matrix

x.en: The Project Manager is part of a weak matrix organization and is playing the role of project expeditor. The project expeditor acts primarily as a staff assistant and communication coordinator. The expeditor personally cannot make or enforce decisions.

q.en: You are working with a couple of research associates to determine if implementing a WiFi system in the neighborhood is going to benefit residents. As part of this effort, you will be working with authorities to get related government documents. Also, you will do an extensive survey on how people will be using the system and create reports from the survey. What do you call this effort?

en: A Research Study
An Operation
A Survey
A Project

x.en: Every project generates a unique product, service, or result. This is a project because it is generating a unique result (knowledge and documentation) and it is temporary. Although not stated explicitly in the question description, the project time-constrained or there is a timeline wherein project tasks will be considered completed (i.e. WiFi system implemented, obtained government-related documents, survey complete, and reports created.)

q.en: Which of the following best describes the role of a project sponsor?

en: Project Sponsor is responsible for managing the project
Project Sponsor is responsible for managing the quality of deliverables
Project Sponsor is responsible for identifying key stakeholders
Project Sponsor is responsible for providing funding for the project

x.en: The sponsor provides funding directly or indirectly and is responsible for approving or denying the budget. The project sponsor is also generally the one who approves the Project Charter, but that is not mentioned in the question.

q.en: In your project meetings, you regularly find that project staff are nodding their heads but do not speak much or ask questions. Which of the below training will help improve this situation?

en: Body language training
Active listening skills
Interpersonal skills
Presentation skills

x.en: Active listening related to acknowledging, confirming, clarifying, understanding and removing communication barriers.

q.en: You are managing an agile software project. Previously you had managed only non-Agile projects. Which type of meetings would you find to be unique to your current project compared to your earlier projects?

en: Sprint meetings
Design meetings
Quality review meetings
Vendor performance review meetings

x.en: Sprint meetings are unique to agile projects.

q.en: You are managing a multinational project with team members across different countries and varying time zones. In this scenario, you wish to choose a communication media which is most efficient to project requirements. What should be the most appropriate way to address this?

en: Discuss the communication requirements and the available options with stakeholders to seek their inputs
Use a combination of communication technology as is done in your peer's project
Explore communication tools available in the market, and ask for quotation exclusively for your project instead of using existing tool in the organization
Use the most cost effective technique, and involve everyone to explain its usage

x.en: It is important to have effective communication media in this project, especially considering the team is in different geographical locations and communication requirements are complex. It is best to take input from the stakeholders of the project and understand their communication requirements before finalizing a technique.

q.en:
A portfolio manager informs the project manager that their project was terminated. The project manager wants to inform
the stakeholders and team members about this. To what document should the project manager refer?

en: Change Management Plan.
Communication management plan.
Resources Management Plan
Responsibility assignments matrix (RAM).

x.en: Keyword (inform) The project manager should refer to the Communication management plan to inform the stakeholders and team members about the project's termination decision. Because the Communication management plan includes who & when & why should send the information.

q.en: After conducting data analysis, a project manager determines the cause and degree of variance relatives to the approved scope. What should the project manager do next?

en: Revise the scope baseline.
Change the performance measurement baseline.
Decide if a corrective or preventative action is required.
Updates the scope management plan.

x.en: Important aspects of project scope control include determining the cause and degree of variance relative to the scope baseline and deciding whether corrective or preventive action is required.

q.en: A Project Manager has delivered a major deliverable of the project. The customer comes back a week after the release saying that he is not entirely satisfied with the deliverable. What should the Project Manager do NEXT?

en: Ensure that the next deliverables have the features that the customer specified and exceed his expectations
Continue with the next deliverable as the project has to be finished on time
Do a scope verification of this deliverable to check if it satisfies project objectives
Talk to the Senior Manager to discuss the customer concern and resolution

x.en: Verifying the project scope includes reviewing deliverables to ensure that each is completed satisfactorily. If this is successful, it should provide customer satisfaction

q.en: A project manager uses the schedule from a similar project to estimate the cost of the project activities for a new project. Which method was used to derive the estimates?

en: Expert judgement.
Parametric estimating.
Bottom-up estimating.
Analogous estimating.

x.en: Keyword ( uses the schedule from a similar project ) Analogous estimates are usually done in the initial stages of the project when limited information is known. They use historical information and expert judgment. Analogous cost estimating is generally less costly and time-consuming compared to other methods, but it is also less accurate.

q.en: Which of the following processes are concerned with comparing the work results with the quality requirements to ensure the result is acceptable?

en: Manage Quality
Control Scope
Validate Scope
Control Quality

x.en: Control Quality is concerned with comparing the work results with the quality requirements to ensure the result is acceptable.

q.en: To improve the quality of project deliverables, the project manager decides to involve the project team in defining project standards, policies, and guidelines. The team thinks that this a waste of effort, and would like to continue to execute the project as planned. What should the project manager do next?

en: Produce the quality management plan, and distribute it to stakeholders.
Meet with individual team members, and force them to comply.
Log an issue with the team and discuss it with the human resources department.
Organize a project team meeting to create a shared vision.

x.en: The project manager should Organize a project team meeting to create a shared vision and the importance of the quality of the project deliverable and this is not a waste of effort and should defining project standards, policies, and guidelines To improve the quality of the project deliverables. The next step Produce the quality management plan, and distribute it to stakeholders.
